item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per specification
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basics. Use only the Python standard library. Run the focused and existing tests, then commit the completed changes on this item branch. Acceptance criteria: behavior conforms to every requirement and error/boundary case in SPEC.md; documented API remains compatible; focused tests exercise the specified errors and boundaries; existing tests pass; commit is created. If the specification or current tests reveal an ambiguous product choice not settled by the repo or spec, ask before choosing.

pr.body: Added implementation in retry_budget.py and focused boundary/error coverage in test_retry_budget.py. Validation rejects bool, float, integer subclasses and out-of-range values before exhausted-attempt returns. Backoff saturates without constructing enormous powers; Retry-After remains an uncapped minimum; retries at or beyond the budget are rejected. Checks: focused and discovery unittest runs passed (8 each), git diff --check passed. Assumption: the spec fully determines behavior; no unresolved product choices.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded retry delay calculation. Callers can safely obtain capped backoff and Retry-After delays within a strict time budget. Before: retry_delay was unimplemented; now: validated scheduling behavior follows the spec.
